rubric_items.reason: All 15 acceptance criteria (S-1 AC1-5, S-2 AC1-4, S-3 AC1, S-4 AC1, S-5 AC1-4) map to at least one TP test, and REQ-1 to REQ-13 are all traced.
API behaviour is tested at integration level with Supertest and a real DB, and page rendering at unit level with jsdom and a mocked client. No e2e or manual tests.

Has negative tests for the list filter (TP-16) and the time zone fallback (TP-17), plus status exclusions. Missing a boundary test for an appointment that starts exactly at now, and an explicit test that past Scheduled appointments are ignored.
Uses the strategy's tools and layers. Names are prefixed 'HMS-1 REQ-n' rather than starting with the ID, and no web test folder or file is named for the PatientsPage tests.
Titles are short and runnable, with level and AC mapping. Q-01/U-1 asks whether to add the very tests the plan already lists, which is a little confusing.
